review_panel.finding: Audited contracts/examples/ranking-calibration.yaml and contracts/json-schema/ranking-calibration.v1.schema.json. Verified threshold bounds, minimum sensitivity requirements, confusion-matrix counts, and strict enforcement of auto_exclusion_prohibited: true.

Audited crates/searchright-contracts/src/ranking.rs, crates/searchright-ranking/src/lib.rs, and tests/test_active_learning_ranking_governance.py. Confirmed that autonomous screening exclusion is strictly prohibited by schema and contract invariants, and stopping rules remain disabled without external evidence and governance approval.

Audited crates/searchright-ranking/src/lib.rs. Verified LexicalRanker title/abstract/subject token overlap scoring, bounded deterministic non-sycophantic scoring, calibrate curve computation (sensitivity/recall, precision, FNR, FPR, and WSS), and division-by-zero protection across all empty/edge-case strata.

Upgraded all six Track 23 assertions (T23-A001..T23-A006) from track_level_only (6/6 empty symbols) to symbol_and_gate_mapped with concrete implementation symbols across crates/searchright-contracts, crates/searchright-ranking, failure-modes.md, and tests/test_active_learning_ranking_governance.py in both conductor/tracks/23-active-learning-agents/traceability.json and conductor/traceability-overrides.json (0/6 empty symbols).

Preserved active learning gating state without premature completion: implementation_state remains scaffolded; SYNERGY and topic-held-out calibration benchmarks, prospective human calibration with subgroup error analysis, and stopping/exclusion authority remain explicitly open.

fixes_applied: Created tests/test_active_learning_ranking_governance.py validating ranking calibration contracts, JSON schema conformance, advisory-only screening safeguards prohibiting automated exclusion, failure mode countermeasures, and Track 23 traceability invariants.

Hardened unit tests in crates/searchright-ranking/src/lib.rs and crates/searchright-contracts/src/ranking.rs without forbidden fragments, verifying LexicalRanker title/abstract weighting, non-negative scores, deterministic scoring, calibrate recall/precision/WSS/FNR/FPR curve calculations, zero division protection, and strict advisory-only claim boundaries.
Implemented Validate and helper ratio/total methods for CalibrationCounts in searchright-contracts, and implemented calibrate, CalibrationPoint, and CalibrationCurve in searchright-ranking.

Upgraded assertions T23-A001 through T23-A006 to symbol_and_gate_mapped with concrete implementation symbols, deterministic tests, and native test commands in both conductor/tracks/23-active-learning-agents/traceability.json and conductor/traceability-overrides.json (0/6 empty symbol mappings).

Preserved open maturity blockers: running SYNERGY and topic-held-out calibration benchmarks, completing prospective human calibration and subgroup error analysis, and keeping stopping/exclusion authority disabled until external evidence and governance approve it.
